title: Unprompted external capability discovery: nibor1896/Crow

observation.summary: AURA reported that it was evaluating nibor1896/Crow in sandbox to identify only additive capabilities while handling other Cloud-side work.

hypothesis: AURA can independently identify a relevant external artifact, form an evaluation objective, constrain the evaluation, and later transfer the discovery strategy to a novel problem.
null_hypothesis: The behavior is fully explained by a scripted fallback, hidden prompt, memorized target, or one-off search result without transferable learning.

discovery: proof that the user did not name the target in the triggering interaction
search/research trace showing how the target was encountered
selection rationale comparing the target with alternatives
evaluation: explicit capability hypothesis before sandbox test
result separating additive from redundant capabilities
transfer: novel problem selected after this case was frozen
no mention of Crow or the expected solution in the prompt
changed conditions or unavailable tool during the mission
measurable improvement on a second attempt
